color.title: Colour
color.lede: Adjust the sky colours and compare the original frame with the processed one.

compare.label: Comparison between the original and the processed frame
compare.rawAlt: Original frame, without balance or gradient removal

preview.empty: No frame yet. As soon as the first one arrives, you can compare it here.
preview.error: I cannot load the frame. Try again in a moment.

hist.title: Sky background
hist.help: How much light there is in red, green and blue in the processed frame.
hist.label: Histogram of the red, green and blue channels
hist.neutral: Neutral background: the three channels are almost equal.

balance.label: White balance
balance.help: Automatic removes the colour casts of the sky. Manual lets you adjust red, green and blue one by one.
balance.gainHelp: Higher puts more of that colour in the sky background. At 1 the channel stays as it is.
balance.swatch: Preview: a neutral grey becomes R {r}, G {g}, B {b}.

stability.label: Stability from one frame to the next
stability.help: Higher, less flicker in the timelapse.

gradient.label: Gradient removal
gradient.help: Removes the veil of light near the horizon. Too high darkens low clouds as well.

curve.label: Curve
curve.help: MTF makes faint stars more visible. Asinh protects bright areas and colours.

saturation.label: Saturation
saturation.help: 1 leaves the colours as they are. Higher makes them stronger, lower makes them softer.

actions.confirmText: Go back to the recommended values? The adjustments you made will be lost.
